nodes.description: Internal transfer override in eVAULT handling blacklist checks, max tx limits, fee taking, liquidation swaps and dividend tracker updates.
Owner-only function enabling trading and swaps via the tradingEnabled and _swapEnabled flags.
Toggles the dev/liquidity fee swap flag but only allows msg.sender equal to liquidityWallet; missing onlyOwner allows privileged state change path.
Public function that calls dividendTracker.process and emits an event using tx.origin as the processor.
Public function letting any caller trigger dividend processing for their own address via processAccount(msg.sender,false).
Private function that swaps tokens for ETH and forwards the ETH to a hardcoded dev/marketing address.
Private function that swaps tokens for the dividend token, transfers it to the tracker and calls distributeDividends.
Private function approving and swapping tokens for ETH through the Uniswap V2 router with block.timestamp as deadline.
Private function swapping tokens for the dividend token through the Uniswap V2 router with block.timestamp as deadline.
Public gas-bounded loop that iterates token holders and auto-claims dividends, advancing lastProcessedIndex.
Only-owner function that withdraws dividends for an account and records block.timestamp as the last claim time.
Only-owner function syncing a holder's balance into the tracker mapping and triggering processAccount.
Overridden transfer in the dividend tracker that always reverts to disable token transfers.
Overridden withdrawDividend in the tracker that always reverts, forcing use of the main claim function.
Internal function that reads accumulated dividend, updates withdrawnDividends and performs an external ERC20 transfer before returning.
Public function distributing dividend amounts to holders by increasing magnifiedDividendPerShare.
Only-owner function excluding an account from dividends and removing it from the token holders map.
Private function toggling the automatedMarketMakerPairs flag and excluding the pair from dividends.
Owner-only function proxying claimWait updates to the dividend tracker.
Attacker-controllable caller address used in access checks, blacklists, claim and fee toggling routes.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for swap deadlines and dividend claim timing.
Transaction origin used only for event emission in dividend processing events.
Native ETH transfer to the hardcoded dev/marketing address inside swapAndSendToDev.
External uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call in swapTokensForEth.
External uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call in swapTokensForDividendToken.
External IERC20(dividendToken).transfer inside _withdrawDividendOfUser executed before function completion.
External IERC20(_dividendToken).transfer to the dividendTracker inside swapAndSendDividends.
Flag gating trading, fees and liquidation; toggled by activate.
Flag gating swap-and-liquidate logic; toggled by activate and enableDisableDevFee.
Reentrancy-style guard flag set during liquidation swaps in _transfer.
Gas budget used when calling dividendTracker.process from _transfer.
Mapping of blacklisted addresses checked in the transfer override.
Reference to the eVAULTDividendTracker contract receiving balance and process calls.
Privileged wallet address used in fee toggling checks and liquidation exclusions.
Cursor into the token holders map maintained by the process loop.
Minimum seconds between dividend claims per account.
Mapping marking accounts excluded from dividend participation.
Source address parameter of the eVAULT transfer override.
Destination address parameter of the eVAULT transfer override.
Amount parameter of the eVAULT transfer override used for fee and max-tx math.
Account whose balance is synced in the dividend tracker.
New balance value compared against the minimum holder threshold.
Gas budget parameter bounding the dividend processing loop.
Token amount swapped into dividends in swapAndSendDividends.
Token amount approved and swapped for ETH in swapTokensForEth.

edges.reason: enableDisableDevFee compares msg.sender to liquidityWallet to authorize toggling fee swapping.
claim passes payable(msg.sender) into processAccount, letting any caller claim their own dividends.
_transfer consults _isBlackListedBot[msg.sender] and applies caller-dependent fee/deadline logic.
processDividendTracker emits tx.origin as the processor and does not restrict processing.
_transfer emits tx.origin inside ProcessedDividendTracker on automatic processing.
processAccount stores block.timestamp into lastClaimTimes and uses it for claim throttling.
process relies on canAutoClaim which compares block.timestamp against lastClaimTimes and claimWait.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline parameter.
swapTokensForDividendToken passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline parameter.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendToDev when the liquidation threshold is reached.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendDividends with the remaining contract balance after the dev swap.
_transfer calls dividendTracker.process(gas) guarded by try/catch while not liquidating.
_transfer calls dividendTracker.setBalance for the from and to addresses after transferring.
_transfer reads tradingEnabled to decide fees, presale gating and liquidation eligibility.
_transfer reads and writes the liquidating guard flag around swap operations.
_transfer enforces blacklist restrictions using the _isBlackListedBot mapping.
_transfer reads gasForProcessing to bound the dividend processing call.
_transfer invokes methods on the dividendTracker state variable.
from is the primary source-address input consumed throughout the transfer override.
to is the destination-address input driving AMM pair detection and max-sell checks.
amount undergoes multiplication and subtraction for fees, and is bounded by MAX_SELL_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT.
activate sets tradingEnabled to true, enabling trading.
activate sets _swapEnabled to true, enabling liquidation swaps.
enableDisableDevFee writes _swapEnabled after comparison against msg.sender rather than onlyOwner.
swapAndSendToDev performs a native ETH transfer to the dev address, enabling an external callback.
swapTokensForEth performs an external Uniswap router swap call that can invoke token/receiver hooks.
swapTokensForDividendToken performs an external Uniswap router swap call with attacker-influenceable price impact.
swapAndSendDividends triggers an external ERC20 transfer of the dividend token to the tracker.
swapAndSendDividends calls distributeDividends on the tracker after a successful transfer.
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs the external dividend token transfer before returning, allowing reentrancy.
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser to compute and pay the claimable amount.
process calls processAccount for holders that satisfy the auto-claim timing check.
setBalance calls processAccount to force a claim for the synced account.
account parameter selects the holder whose balance and exclusion state are updated.
newBalance determines mint/burn and whether the account stays in the holders map.
gas parameter bounds the processing loop and controls the gasUsed computation.
tokens parameter is swapped into dividend token inside swapAndSendDividends.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped for ETH inside swapTokensForEth.
Native ETH transfer to an external address can re-enter the eVAULT transfer path via the receive function.
ERC20 dividend transfer can re-enter _withdrawDividendOfUser because withdrawnDividends bookkeeping races with the external call.
ERC20 dividend transfer to the tracker can re-enter swapAndSendDividends before distributeDividends completes.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a local parameter only meaningful inside the eVAULT transfer override.
to is a local parameter consumed only by the transfer override's pair and max-sell logic.
amount is a local parameter used solely for fee and max transaction arithmetic in _transfer.
account is a local parameter of setBalance used to update the holder tracking map.
newBalance is a local parameter compared against minimumTokenBalanceForDividends in setBalance.
gas is a local parameter bounding the holder iteration loop inside process.
tokens is a local parameter swapped into dividend currency inside swapAndSendDividends.
tokenAmount is a local parameter approved and swapped for ETH inside swapTokensForEth.
